ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the base side of quadrilateral PQRS is the horizontal PQ, point T is between P and Q, ST is the line segment from S perpendicular to PQ, and its length is labeled as 5. Point R is directly above Q, so QR is perpendicular to PQ. The figure also marks ∠PQR as a right angle, ∠PSR as a right angle, and the problem gives PS=RS. Reasoning: According to the coordinate method, set T=(0,0). Because ST=5 and S is directly above T, S=(0,5). Let P=(-x,0), where x>0. Thus vector SP=P-S=(-x,-5). Since PS=RS and ∠PSR=90°, vector SR is a 90° rotation of vector SP and has the same length. According to the direction in the figure, take SR=(5,-x), so R=S+SR=(5,5-x). Also because QR is perpendicular to the horizontal base side PQ, Q is directly below R, therefore Q=(5,0). Use the shoelace formula to calculate the area of quadrilateral P Q R S, with coordinates in order P=(-x,0), Q=(5,0), R=(5,5-x), S=(0,5). The first group product sum is (-x)(0)+5(5-x)+5(5)+0(0)=50-5x. The second group product sum is 0(5)+0(5)+(5-x)(0)+5(-x)=-5x. Area = 1/2 |(50-5x)-(-5x)| = 1/2·50 = 25.

method.method_draft: Use an analytic coordinate setup. From the image, take P, T, Q collinear on the horizontal base, with S directly above T and R directly above Q. Let T=(0,0), S=(0,5), and P=(-x,0), since ST=5. The text gives PS=RS and angle PSR=90 degrees, so vector SR is a 90-degree rotation of vector SP. In the pictured orientation, SP=(-x,-5), so SR=(5,-x). Hence R=(5,5-x) and, because QR is vertical to the base, Q=(5,0). Compute the area of quadrilateral P Q R S by the shoelace formula with coordinates P=(-x,0), Q=(5,0), R=(5,5-x), S=(0,5); the x terms cancel and the area is 25.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中四边形 PQRS 的底边是水平的 PQ，点 T 在 P 与 Q 之间，ST 是从 S 垂直到 PQ 的线段，并标注长度为 5。点 R 在 Q 的正上方，所以 QR 垂直于 PQ。图中还标出 ∠PQR 为直角，∠PSR 为直角，且题目给出 PS=RS。

推理：按坐标法设 T=(0,0)，因为 ST=5 且 S 在 T 正上方，所以 S=(0,5)。令 P=(-x,0)，其中 x>0。于是向量 SP=P-S=(-x,-5)。由于 PS=RS 且 ∠PSR=90°，向量 SR 是向量 SP 的 90°旋转且长度相同。按图中方向取 SR=(5,-x)，所以 R=S+SR=(5,5-x)。又因为 QR 垂直于水平底边 PQ，Q 在 R 的正下方，因此 Q=(5,0)。

用鞋带公式计算四边形 P Q R S 的面积，坐标依次为 P=(-x,0), Q=(5,0), R=(5,5-x), S=(0,5)。
第一组乘积和为 (-x)(0)+5(5-x)+5(5)+0(0)=50-5x。
第二组乘积和为 0(5)+0(5)+(5-x)(0)+5(-x)=-5x。
面积 = 1/2 |(50-5x)-(-5x)| = 1/2·50 = 25。

The text says PS=RS and angle PSR=90 degrees, so SR is obtained by rotating PS by 90 degrees; therefore the horizontal projection from S to R equals ST=5, giving TQ=5, and the vertical drop from S to R equals PT=x, giving QR=5-x. Then area(PQRS)=area(triangle PTS)+area(trapezoid TQRS) = (1/2)x(5)+(1/2)(ST+QR)(TQ) = (5x/2)+(1/2)(5+5-x)(5)=25.
